# Conscious
AI platform for reflective journaling & habit insights: themes, mood trend, and which habits (gym, sleep, study...) correlate with better mood.
## Run
echo "Gym today felt great" | python3 app.py

## Test
python3 test_app.py

## Roadmap
LLM-based theme extraction, weekly insight emails, web UI, streak tracking.

## Web UI
python3 web.py  # http://localhost:8000

## Climate Build Sprint
Adds carbon-habit tagging: tag journal entries (commute, food, energy) to see mood vs footprint habits.
